description: Click Segurança helps companies manage workplace safety activities in one place, from inspections, risk analyses, checklists, PPE controls, evidence, action plans, dashboards, and reports to AI-supported workflows. Teams can use the platform in the office or in the field, including offline data capture for remote operations. With conversational access to safety data, users can review indicators, trends, recurring causes, and evidence in natural language to support faster, better-informed safety decisions.
